text:
Oliver (Eng-Platform): Heads-up — scheduling a change window for a runtime & kernel update in us-west-2 on Thu 15 May 2025 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need statuspage copy + customer email. Canary then rollout. @Maya can you own comms? Also we may pin model versions briefly for safety.

Maya (Support): on it. will draft a short statuspage + email. any SLA exceptions or customer groups to call out?

Anna (Customer Success): Heads-up: two enterprise customers on reserved pools: AlphaHealth and Finlytics. I'll do PM outreach once we have the draft.

Tara (Oncall): Ops note: fallback plan routes traffic to a compatible model variant (v1.3) in-region. Expect latency bump ~150-300ms for some endpoints. Canary will run at 10% traffic for ~20m. If error_rate > 1% -> hold and escalate.

Oliver (Eng-Platform): deploy-bot will run the canary at 02:00 UTC. If canary green, full rollout at 02:30. Rollback on quality regression.

deploy-bot: [system] create-deploy job queued: job_id=job_20250515_02_usw2_canary. logs: https://internal-ci/build/1234

Maya (Support): Draft statuspage snippet below — please edit inline: 

```
status: maintenance
component: Runtime API (us-west-2)
impact: Partial degradation for reserved/dedicated customers; hosted continues to be routed to healthy clusters.
start: Thu, 15 May 2025 02:00 UTC
estimated_end: Thu, 15 May 2025 03:00 UTC
description: We're applying a kernel and runtime update to improve stability and memory management. During the window some requests from reserved pools may be temporarily routed to a compatible model variant (v1.3), which can cause intermittent latency increases. We'll monitor quality and performance and post updates here.
communication_channels: statuspage, in-product banner, email to affected accounts, targeted PM outreach.
contact: support@redwood.example
```

Oliver (Eng-Platform): Small edits: change 'compatible model variant (v1.3)' -> keep, + add rollback sentence: "If we observe quality regressions during canary or rollout we'll rollback to the pre-change model and notify customers with a post-incident summary." Also add note to top: "Maintenance ID: RED-20250515-runtime-update"

Anna (Customer Success): Add line for enterprise PMs: "Enterprise customers on reserved pools will receive a separate PM 24h before the window. If you are listed as an approver, reply with approval ASAP."

Maya (Support): Email subject suggestion: 
"Planned maintenance: runtime update in us-west-2 — possible short latency increases"

Maya (Support): Email body (short draft):

```
Subject: Planned maintenance: runtime update in us-west-2 (15 May 2025)

Hi <CustomerName>,

We're planning a brief maintenance window to apply a runtime and kernel update in the us-west-2 region on Thu, 15 May 2025 from 02:00–03:00 UTC. During this time some requests from reserved or dedicated pools may be routed to a compatible model variant (v1.3), which can cause short, intermittent latency increases (expected ~150–300ms). Hosted customers are expected to be unaffected.

If you have reserved capacity in us-west-2 and need to opt out or coordinate a different window, reply to this message or contact support@redwood.example.

We will post updates to our status page during the window: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/RED-20250515-runtime-update

Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

Tara (Oncall): Ops rule for canary: pause rollout if any of: error_rate > 1% OR 95th latency increases > 500ms OR quality regression flagged by eval checks. If paused, tag @Oliver + @Tara and we'll triage.

Oliver (Eng-Platform): Ack. I'll add the rollout & rollback notes to the release notes doc and pin the maintenance ID. Who will post the initial statuspage update at 02:00?

Maya (Support): I'll post and update the statuspage. Will also send the email batch to affected accounts right after canary start.

deploy-bot: [system] canary started: job_id=job_20250515_02_usw2_canary. monitoring: perfcharts.internal/redwood/job_1234

deploy-bot: [system] canary metrics snapshot: error_rate=0.12%, 95p_latency=210ms, token_throughput stable. -> PASS thresholds.

deploy-bot: [system] promoting to full-rollout: job_id=job_20250515_02_usw2_full.

Maya (Support): Posting initial status update: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/RED-20250515-runtime-update — note: I'm adding the PM list and linking the enterprise contact notes.

Anna (Customer Success): PMs to AlphaHealth + Finlytics sent. AlphaHealth asked for a short post-change summary — noted.

Tara (Oncall): Full rollout in progress. Monitoring dashboards clear so far. Will escalate if anything drifts.

deploy-bot: [system] full-rollout completed: job_id=job_20250515_02_usw2_full. summary: kernel bump + runtime pin logic applied.

Maya (Support): Posting resolved update and brief post-incident note on statuspage now.

Oliver (Eng-Platform): Final release notes bullet (for release board): "RED-20250515-runtime-update — kernel bump, runtime safeguard to pin model variants during unstable conditions, canary-first rollout, fallback routing to v1.3 in-region when necessary."

Maya (Support): Closing thread. Will attach the statuspage incident ID & email batch logs to the maintenance ticket.
